items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: there was a teacher named Elsie Clark... I was always glad to see her come in

ctx.x: Were your mother and father sort of church-going people?

They were church-going people. Both church-going. And they would frown upon those kind of records, you know, but I'd always make it my business to try to hide the records and before they could get rid of them, I'd hide them somewhere. I'd get rid of the records for them, you know, and so, you know, when I was in school -- you know when you're in school, there's always a music teacher that comes around, you know, and I had never given any thought to music one way or the other and there was a teacher named Elsie…
Just say her name again, will you, Jay?
